newsitem.title: USA: PP&L asks industrial users to cut power use.
newsitem.headline: PP&L asks industrial users to cut power use.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power & Light Co (PP&L) said Wednesday it asked about 80 large industrial customers to reduce power usage this afternoon due to heavy weather-related demand on its system.
In an effort to conserve energy, demand reduction from those customers was to take effect at 1330 EDT, PP&L said.

The large customers whose service was to be interrupted have special contracts with PP&L--in exchange for cheaper rates--that require them to reduce power and/or curtail operations during an emergency, PP&L said.

In addition to calling for large industrial users to reduce their usage, PP&L also requested all customers to use energy sparingly and shift use of major electric appliances such as washing machines and clothes dryers to early morning or evening hours.
"We will continue to update the public and our customers on the status of this situation," said Bob Hinkel, manager of PP&L's transmission and distribution operations.
PP&L, a subsidiary of PP&L Resources, serves 1.2 million customers in central and eastern Pennsylvania.
